meta.title: Approve plan → Move to Trash: call sequence

messages.label: executeDisplayedPlan(digest, cancellation)
messages.note: digest: pendingApprovalDigestHex from the approval request, via AppState; isExecuting = true

messages.label: ApprovedTrashOperationFactory().makeOperations
messages.note: evaluates ApprovalValidity; attestation and context come from the displayed plan

messages.label: failure(.invalidApproval / .emptyPlan)
messages.note: Only digest match and plan expiry can fail here; any rejection becomes .planChanged.

messages.label: failure(.planChanged)
messages.note: refusedRun: nothing moved; finishRun then calls refresh()

messages.label: success([MoveToTrash])
messages.note: one MoveToTrash per plan target

messages.label: revalidate(revalidationRootKinds)
messages.note: plan-target roots only (all six if none); never the shared scan

messages.label: failure(.scanFailed)
messages.note: refusedRun before the run: nothing moved

messages.label: AdaptiveScanCollection
messages.note: fresh findings and policy evaluations

messages.label: success(source) via stoppedBeforeRun()
messages.note: Stop seen after makeOperations or after the scan; makeSource() rescans all six roots

messages.label: failure(history refused)
messages.note: .historyBusy, .reviewRequired or .receiptHistoryUnavailable: lock busy, 50 unresolved receipts, history could not open, makeIntent threw or intent write failed

messages.label: run(intent:operations:freshEvidence:isCancelled:)
messages.note: freshEvidence: FreshTargetEvidence.observing after the second Stop check, only findings the fresh policy pass allows

messages.label: recoverDeletingTombstones(), loadAll()
messages.note: under the lease; admission: ReceiptRetention.decide, else .reviewRequired

messages.label: persistIntent(intent)
messages.note: writes <receipt id>/intent.json before any move

messages.label: persistTransition(.started)
messages.note: loop: isCancelled() breaks before the item

messages.label: execute.revalidateAndMove(_:fresh:)
messages.note: records each outcome, then the receipt adapter calls FoundationTrashAdapter

messages.label: skippedStale(reason)
messages.note: revalidator, unresolved root, or final identity probe

messages.label: failed(.nativeMoveFailed)
messages.note: FileManager.trashItem threw

messages.label: moved(destination)
messages.note: after FileManager.trashItem succeeds

messages.label: persistTransition(terminal)
messages.note: Self.terminal: moved, skippedStale, failed or cancelled

messages.label: loadAll(), deleteReceipt(id)
messages.note: pruneLocked after the loop; result ignored

messages.label: failure(ReceiptPersistenceError)
messages.note: recorded: .partial, .receiptIncomplete; else refusal

messages.label: success(ReconciledReceipt)
messages.note: runState(aggregate): complete, interrupted or partial

messages.label: makeSource(): SharedScanStore.refresh()
messages.note: shared six-root rescan for the next plan

messages.label: AdaptiveScanCollection
messages.note: session then runs DisplayedPlanFactory.makePlan

messages.label: listRedacted()
messages.note: separate call; takes the lease again; a failure says why

messages.label: failure(.scanFailed / .presentationFailed)
messages.note: after the run, items may have moved: collect() or makePlan threw

messages.label: success(AdaptiveExperienceSource)
messages.note: finishRun: isExecuting = false; apply(source) shows outcomes

cards.title: Refusals
items: .sessionUnavailable if the launch session or version context could not be built
.planChanged also when displayedPlan is nil or the approved hex digest does not decode
Every refusal except .sessionUnavailable goes through refusedRun or refusedByHistory, which clear outcomes; no item has moved
A .scanFailed or .presentationFailed from the refresh after a run is not a refusal: items may have moved
finishRun always clears isExecuting; only .planChanged and .receiptIncomplete also call refresh()

cards.title: Stop
items: stopRun sets the shared TrashRunCancellation flag; it is not a call into the session
The session checks it after makeOperations and after the scan (stoppedBeforeRun)
The coordinator checks it before each item and breaks the loop; later items get no transition
Items that never ran stay planned; ReceiptReconciliation marks them cancelled and sets the aggregate to .interrupted
TrashItemOutcome.cancelled is mapped by every wrapper, but FoundationTrashAdapter never returns it

cards.title: Single mutation
items: FoundationTrashAdapter is the only caller of FileManager.trashItem(at:resultingItemURL:)
Before it: FreshEvidenceRevalidator.validate, resolveRoot (user Library Caches only), final identity probe
The probe compares device, inode, size and mtime, requires link count 1 and rejects symlinked components
Call chain: RecordingReceiptExecution → FoundationReceiptExecutionAdapter → FoundationTrashAdapter
FoundationReceiptExecutionAdapter maps ReturnedTrashURL to PrivateRecoveryDestination

cards.title: Receipts
items: Stored under Application Support/MyMacCleaner/Receipts, mode 0700, excluded from backup
Each item persists a started transition, then its terminal transition
Any persist failure ends the run; outcomes already recorded give a partial state and .receiptIncomplete

cards.title: Glossary
items: Digest: SHA-256 of the canonical review plan; approval carries it as hex
Intent: intent.json with plan digest, versions, ordered item IDs and size estimates, written before any move
Admission: a new run is admitted only while fewer than 50 receipts are unresolved, else .reviewRequired
Lease (flock): non-blocking exclusive lock on MyMacCleaner/receipts.lock, beside Receipts, for one run, listing or delete; busy fails with .historyBusy
Tombstone: a receipt folder renamed .deleting-<id> before removal; leftovers are removed at the next locked access
